user.title: Connect Eaton SecureConnect
user.description: Use the application UUID and name of an existing dedicated SecureConnect pairing. This is not the keypad PIN. Areas and zones are discovered automatically. Home Assistant stores your credentials; session tokens are kept in memory.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in rejected or pairing not found.
error.cannot_connect: Communication failed or unexpected data. Check the Eaton app.

init.title: Eaton options
init.description: Cloud polling can miss brief events. Enabling controls allows authorized HA users and automations to arm/disarm without an additional Eaton PIN. Saving these options does not send alarm commands.
